observations.code_quote: Those words have to name the whole project, not only part of its name. Projects often share a name and differ by a qualifier such as "development", "dev", "staging", "test", "sandbox" or "local", and that kind of project holds test traffic, not real users. A message that says only the shared part and leaves the qualifier off has not named the qualified project, even when no project on the list carries the shorter name. With a project called "Fernwood sandbox", "how many orders did Fernwood take today" names no project: it asks about the real product, and the default is where that data is.
